groups.name: Deserts
groups.fact: The Atacama is one of the driest places on Earth.

groups.name: Highest peak of a continent
groups.fact: Aconcagua, at about 6,960 m, is the highest mountain outside Asia.

groups.name: Rivers that flow through a capital
groups.fact: The banks of the Seine in Paris are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

groups.name: Called a "sea" but really a lake
groups.fact: The Caspian is the largest inland body of water on Earth.
